findings.title: Uninstrumented analysis is simultaneously presented as a clean history
findings.what: For every ready analysis with zero recommendations, the top alert says “your history looks clean.” That conclusion ignores domainCoverage. A ready result can have no recommendations because no domain is instrumented, so the same render presents six “Needs data”/“uninstrumented” cards while making an unsupported clean-history claim.
findings.fix: Derive the no-findings alert from domain coverage: use clean language only when all required domains have current sufficient coverage; otherwise say no findings were produced and explicitly qualify that one or more domains need data.
findings.acceptance: Render a ready analysis with zero recommendations and six uninstrumented domain-coverage entries; assert the alert does not contain “looks clean” and identifies incomplete coverage. Also retain a covered-zero-findings case that does render the clean verdict.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the alert branches solely on recs.length at src/components/DigestSpine.tsx:600-605, while domainCoverage is independently consumed at lines 331-339. The batch test at src/components/DigestSpine.test.ts:323-347 reproduces the contradiction by asserting both the clean alert and six uninstrumented cards, so this is current behavior rather than speculation.

findings.title: Recommendation rendering rebuilds and rescans session indexes N times
findings.what: exampleSessionIdForRecommendation constructs a Set and Map from every session for each recommendation card. If structured evidence does not match, it then nests every evidence string over both full and shortened session IDs. Rendering R fixes therefore repeats indexing R times and can approach O(R × E × S) string scans on a history-sized sessions array.
findings.fix: Memoize full-ID and short-ID session indexes once per sessions value, then resolve all recommendation examples from those shared indexes; prefer structured evidenceRefs and bound any legacy evidence-string fallback.
findings.acceptance: Instrument index construction in a render containing multiple recommendations and a large sessions array; verify each session index is built once per sessions change, recommendation navigation results remain unchanged, and legacy evidence fallback has a documented bound.
findings.verifyNote: The second pass re-read the complete resolver and both call sites. Lines 290 and 296 rebuild session collections on every invocation, lines 302-308 perform nested legacy scans, and renderFixEvidenceButton invokes the resolver for each rendered fix. The batch tests at src/components/DigestSpine.test.ts:453-500 cover correctness but provide no shared-index or workload bound.
